# mimux

> A fast, keyboard-driven email client you run yourself — one Go binary, one
> SQLite file, no third party in the middle. The client is free and AGPL-3.0
> forever; a paid automation layer (REST API, MCP server, webhooks) is on the
> roadmap, so agents can act on an inbox that lives on your own hardware.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.mimux.dev): install, configuration, OAuth setup and the API reference.
- [Screenshots and quick start](https://mimux.dev/#install): one `docker compose up`, zero configuration to boot.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux): the full source, AGPL-3.0 client plus the ELv2 pro layer.
- [Issues](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux/issues): bug reports and questions; issues yes, PRs usually no.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://mimux.dev/#pricing): the client is free forever; the automation layer will be €49/yr or €99 perpetual.
- [Account portal](https://account.mimux.dev): licence purchase and management, opens when the pro layer ships.

## Licence

- [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux/blob/main/LICENSING.md): which directory is under which licence, and how to verify the split.
